project_type: Node 22 ES-module HTTP server (src/server.js, createAppServer) + vanilla browser JS pages in public/ (tablet display app.js, admin dashboard.js); no runtime npm dependencies
language: JavaScript (ES modules on the server; ES5-style var/function in public/*.js)
build_system: none; npm scripts only. `npm run check` = node --check src/*.js public/*.js && node --test
test_framework: node:test with node:assert/strict, files in test/*.test.js; server tests start a real createAppServer on a free port via helper start(t,{env,...options}) in test/server.test.js; page tests read public/* source and assert regexes or run extracted functions with new Function
verification_instructions: Run `npm run check` (must pass). For FEAT-003 also run `node tools/e2e-intercom.mjs` (starts `node src/server.js` from the repo folder on a spare port with DEMO_MODE=true and a test ADMIN_TOKEN given through the environment, and drives ~/.cache/puppeteer/chrome-headless-shell/mac_arm-131.0.6778.204/chrome-headless-shell-mac-arm64/chrome-headless-shell with --use-fake-device-for-media-stream --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream over http://localhost, a secure context). Before committing run `git add` for new files, then `bash scripts/update-manifests.sh`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: MANIFEST.txt and SHA256SUMS are generated from git ls-files by `bash scripts/update-manifests.sh` and committed; run it after editing any doc or adding a file, before the commit.
environment_constraints: Work directly on main in /Users/kshitjisharma/Desktop/Kiosks/Conference-Room-Kiosks (no worktree). Commit locally, NEVER push, NEVER deploy, NEVER contact the live server 192.168.80.19 or the tablets (192.168.80.172, .179). Do not print or commit .env values, ADMIN_TOKEN or the Fully Remote Admin password; there is no local .env, pass test settings through the process environment. key_patterns: Door camera is the model: src/server.js lines ~231-280 and ~685-710 (admin-only routes under /api/admin/, who = who.via === 'session' ? who.session.email : 'the administrator token', one logger.log line per use, SSE event so the tablet shows #cameraNotice badge), public/app.js showCamera, public/dashboard.js cameraView, tests 'Door camera' in test/server.test.js. Tablet fields ride the heartbeat like battery (batteryFrom/recordTablet in src/server.js; fullyBattery/batteryInfo/heartbeat in public/app.js).
